LayoutEditor__Publish__Meta.Meta__Purpose: What publishing does, where it asks first, and every word it says
LayoutEditor__Publish__Meta.Meta__Note: Folder names, file names and the tier ladder are NOT here - they are in 53__Data__Layout__PublishedSchema, because the reader must agree about them. This file holds only what the publisher decides alone.

LayoutEditor__Publish__Behaviour.Behaviour__AppVersionNote: Stamped into every manifest and the index as Publish__ByAppVersion. The app keeps its version only in the DEVLOG headings, so this is bumped with each release that changes what is published.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Behaviour.Behaviour__PushNote: Off by default: a publish files everything into the project folder first, where it can be looked at on localhost before a client ever can. Pushing to R2 is a second, deliberate tick.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Behaviour.Behaviour__BakePdfNote: The PDF is baked by the same exporter the editor's Download PDF uses, so the reader's PDF button downloads a finished file and builds nothing. Turning this off leaves readers without a PDF.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Behaviour.Behaviour__RetireOrphansNote: A published document whose sheet no longer exists in the register - renumbered, re-phased or deleted - is archived locally and taken off R2, but ONLY when every sheet is being published at once. A partial publish never retires anything; it reports what it found.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Behaviour.Behaviour__SpecNote: The specification is waited for before a sheet is baked, as the PDF does: the notes margin prints its notes and each bubble's note travels with it.

LayoutEditor__Publish__Labels.Labels__PanelIntro: Publishing bakes each drawing into the files the web viewer shows - a picture and linework for every viewport, the markup, and the PDF - so a phone opening a drawing renders nothing. A drawing that is not published shows its sheet with a grey panel saying so.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Labels.Labels__PushToR2: Also push to R2 (clients see it)
LayoutEditor__Publish__Labels.Labels__DoneR2: Published {count} drawing(s) and pushed them to R2.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Labels.Labels__Orphans: {count} published drawing(s) no longer match a sheet: {ids}. Publish all drawings to retire them.
LayoutEditor__Publish__Labels.Labels__Retired: Retired {ids}: archived here and taken off R2.
